title: bryophyllum sulphureum
intro: Bryophyllum sulphureum, commonly known as Kalanchoe, is a succulent plant species that belongs to the family Crassulaceae. The plant has been traditionally used for its medicinal properties, providing various health benefits such as reducing inflammation and exhibiting antimicrobial activities. The therapeutic actions of Bryophyllum sulphureum include its antioxidant and anti-inflammatory properties, which have been attributed to its ability to scavenge free radicals and inhibit pro-inflammatory enzymes. The bioactive constituents present in the plant include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and terpenoids, which are responsible for its medicinal properties.
